absolute-freshness policy for the missing Valid-Until
privileged bounded package executor (later M1 apply/install step)
CTO decision on ADR-0002 and a D-005 exception
containment_assessment.scope: LUBARCHY-managed automatic transactions (normal APT candidate selection and dependency resolution)
containment_assessment.statement: YES — NVIDIA's Debian 13 repository can be technically contained as a candidate D-005 exception.

executor_requirements: package names come from the validated plan, not caller-controlled text
package versions and source/release selectors cannot be injected by caller input
use APT non-interactively through a bounded API/command construction
revalidate the plan immediately before mutation
record the transaction and validation result

freshness.note: Persist the newest accepted signed Release Date and InRelease hash; reject a Date regression and a same-Date content change. No maximum age is justified by evidence (two observations only); absolute freshness needs a future explicit policy.

limitations: Containment scope: the policy governs APT candidate selection for normal resolution (install, upgrade, dist-upgrade, dependencies, target-release). APT preferences are not a sandbox or MAC mechanism against root. Observed in APT 3.0.3: an explicit exact-version administrator request (apt-get install pkg=version) overrides candidate selection for the named package; this is a privileged override outside the containment boundary. LUBARCHY-managed transactions must go through a future privileged bounded package executor that installs only a validated plan.
Acquire-By-Hash is 'no': index fetches can race a repository update (hash-mismatch failure, fail closed); content substitution is still detected through the signed SHA256 chain.
No Valid-Until: a replayed older signed index is only detectable by the monotonic Release Date rule.
purpose: Branch-615 containment proof for ADR-0002 (Proposed). Not an authorised source, not a production branch decision, not installed or referenced by any build or CI component.

repository.bootstrap: Not authorised. Candidate procedure: LUBARCHY ships the key in its own signed packaging (P-007) after verifying the full fingerprint against this source-controlled value through an independently qualified channel; neither cuda-keyring nor 8793F200.pub (same-origin HTTPS) is a trust anchor; the cuda-archive-keyring.gpg fallback URL returned 404 during M1-G and M1-H.
